task: migrate armD turn curriculum onto the R4000 continuation start point

status.note: this phase delivers scripts, configs and offline checks only; nothing is launched without --run

authorisation.interpretation: the operator's question is taken as the explicit start instruction that stage 1 was waiting for

budget_change.wording: 课程A到1500后请你启动测评开启课程B
budget_change.decision: A endpoint = model_1500; B runs 1500 rounds; both 16000x128x1500

start.optimizer_reason: the governing R4000 entry calls runner.load(..., load_cfg={'actor': True, 'critic': True}) and therefore restores neither the optimizer nor the iteration counter. A and B use the identical weights-only init, so no arm gets an advantage from optimiser state.
start.optimizer_state_shape_note: 17 parameter entries under one param group with exp_avg shapes (16,), (128,65), ... which match actor+critic parameter shapes; it is structurally loadable but is deliberately not loaded because the governing entry does not load it and both arms must be restored the same way.

contract.wheel_positive_means: rolling forward for all four wheels

shared_run.env_step_budget_note: operator instruction 2026-11-17 09:25: A stops at 1500 as the A endpoint and B runs 1500 rounds, so the pair stays equal-budget at 16000*128*1500 = 3,072,000,000 env steps per arm; this supersedes the earlier 3000-round budget

resource_preflight.envs_risk: 16000 parallel Isaac environments on a single L40 44 GiB card has not been run before in this project (R4000 used 4096); memory must be measured at launch and the arm must not start if allocation fails
resource_preflight.ppo_batch_note: transitions per iteration 2,048,000 with 4 minibatches = 512,000 per minibatch, which is 5.33x the R4000 per-iteration batch; this deviates from R4000's PPO batch shape and is shared by both arms, so it must be recorded when comparing against R4000
resource_preflight.wall_clock_note: 3000 iterations x 2,048,000 transitions is 15.6x R4000's work; schedule expectations must be set from a measured first-iteration throughput, not from a guess

shared_run.num_steps_per_env_source: the frozen R4000 entry has no switch for num_steps_per_env and would use the runner default 24; train_ab_entry.py forces the config value (128) through the same import hook it uses for the arm-B curriculum, so both arms get 128 identically

curriculum.release_after_turn: none (release happens only through the existing brake/park semantics)

B.name: B_turn_curriculum_migrated

curriculum.sampler: turn-curriculum-migration/scripts/turn_schedule.py TurnSchedule, installed by rebinding as2w_isaac_speed_range.RollingSpeedCommands (no snapshot file is rewritten)

turn_long.followed_by: explicit zero-command release segment of U(3.0, 3.5) s

B.requested_arc_vx_resolution: the frozen R4000 stage samples |vx| <= 0.20 m/s (speed_cap 0.20), so a 0.25 m/s arc would widen the speed domain at the same time as changing the turn curriculum, which the first round forbids. B therefore uses vx=0.20 m/s, the maximum in-range value, and keeps 0.25 for a later single-variable speed experiment.

differences_B_vs_A: within the mixed branch the category shares change from pure_turn .40 / arc .15 / straight .45 to pure_turn .30 / turn_long .15 / arc .25 / straight .30
a new turn_long category gets a dwell of 8-12 s instead of the global 1.1-3.4 s
every turn_long segment is followed by an explicit zero-command release of 3.0-3.5 s
arcs become bidirectional (A samples forward only) and their yaw magnitude is drawn from the small set {0.02, 0.04, 0.06} rad/s instead of U(0.035, 0.120)
arc forward speed moves from 0.05 to 0.20 m/s, still inside the frozen 0.20 m/s stage cap
no change to: observation, network, action wrapper, control contract, rewards, PPO, init, total env steps, randomisation, held-out seeds, speed cap, yaw cap, perturbation or payload range

evaluation_plan_after_authorisation.same_entry: evaluate R4000 start, A and B with the same frozen matrix entry and the same held-out seeds
evaluation_plan_after_authorisation.start_evaluated_as_original_checkpoint: model_3999.pt is evaluated directly; model_0.pt is not used as the start because it may be rewritten by any later run
evaluation_plan_after_authorisation.selection: worst side across held-out seeds, base/hard-protection gates first, then turning
evaluation_plan_after_authorisation.long_turn_verification: 8-12 s sustained turn events must appear in the real rollout, not only in the sampler
